aiVerification.summary: Draft mixes DOE weld-time testing with sorting/recheck data, so the changed factor and outcomes are not verified.
issues: Changed factor improperly combines two sheets and unrelated contexts.
DOE factor appears to be weld time/test condition, not the long generated condition string.
Only one test row is compared while other cited DOE rows likely represent additional time settings.
Sorting C2 move E2 results are treated as the same changed-factor outcome without support.
Several cited rows are not summarized in context, limiting verification of grouping.
correctionPlan: Separate DOE spot-welding test from C2 sorting/recheck unless source proves one validation context.
Define baseline as Normal at 38ms and tests by each weld-time setting if supported.
Group all DOE rows by date/type/time/input/OK/NG/rate before judging outcome.
Keep sorting/recheck rows as context or a separate outcome only if comparable conditions are clear.
Revise evidence rows to include headers and every row used for each subgroup.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row existence is sufficient, but citations do not yet support final grouping or judgement.
